Unique as the only south-facing (Dakshinabhimukhi) Jyotirlinga, possessing profound power to conquer untimely death (Akal Mrityu). Famous worldwide for the sacred Bhasma Aarti performed each dawn with fresh sacred ash.

The primordial Jyotirlinga ("Prathamam Somanatham Cha"). Stands on the shores of the Arabian Sea where an arrow-pillar (Bāna Stambha) marks that no landmass exists in a straight line between Somnath and Antarctica.

Highest of all 12 Jyotirlingas, situated at 3,583 meters against the snowy Kedarnath peaks. It is both a prime Jyotirlinga and the crowning jewel of the Chota Char Dham circuit.
04:00 प्रातः – 09:00 संध्या (Temple opens on Akshaya Tritiya / Vaisakh and closes on Bhai Dooj / Kartik)
Remarkable sacred site where a Jyotirlinga and an 18 Maha Shakti Peetha (Bhramaramba) co-exist in the same holy complex on Srisailam mountain (Kailasa of the South).
04:30 प्रातः – 10:00 संध्या (Suprabhatप्रातः: 05:00 प्रातः, Sparsha Darshan available)

Situated on Mandhata Island in river Narmada, naturally contoured in the exact sacred geometric shape of the sacred syllable "ॐ" (Om). Visited alongside Mamleshwar (Amareshwar) on the southern bank to complete the pilgrimage.
05:00 प्रातः – 09:30 संध्या (मंगला आरती: 05:00 प्रातः, Shayan Aarti: 08:30 संध्या)
Unique Jyotirlinga enshrining a hollow cavity with three small thumb-sized lingams representing the Trimurti: Brahma, Vishnu, and Rudra. Site of the sacred Nashik-Trimbak Kumbh Mela.
05:30 प्रातः – 09:00 संध्या (Rudrabhishek, Narayan Nagbali & Kalsarpa pujas)

The 6th sacred Jyotirlinga nestled deep in the lush Sahyadri Western Ghats where the sacred Bhima river originates. Consecrated on the exact spot Lord Shiva vanquished the demon Bhima, son of Kumbhakarna, to protect his devotee King Priyadharman.
04:30 प्रातः – 09:30 संध्या (Maha Abhishek: 04:30 प्रातः; संध्या आरती: 07:30 संध्या)

One of the most revered Jyotirlingas, famously known as Chitabhoomi and Kamada Lingam (fulfiller of all pure desires). Unique sanctuary where Shiva and Shakti shrines are tied together with sacred red silk ribbons (Gathbandhan). Renowned for the annual 105-km barefoot Kanwar Yatra from Sultanganj.
04:00 प्रातः – 09:00 संध्या (Sarkari Pooja: 04:00 प्रातः; Shringaar Aarti: 07:30 संध्या)
पश्चिमी चार धाम में भगवान श्रीकृष्ण की पावन द्वारिकापुरी।

The 12th and ultimate Jyotirlinga immortalized in the Dwadasha Jyotirlinga Stotram. Located adjacent to the UNESCO World Heritage Ellora Caves, celebrated for the pure maternal devotion of Grushma whose deceased son was resurrected by Mahadeva.
दक्षिणी चार धाम जहाँ श्रीराम ने लंका विजय पूर्व ज्योतिर्लिंग स्थापित किया।
